note: Illustrative, OECD-model-aligned bilateral withholding-tax matrix for intercompany royalty and intra-group service payments. Treaty rates are the REDUCED rate that applies where a tax treaty / EU directive is in force between the source (payer) and residence (payee) country; statutory is the source country's domestic fallback where no treaty relief is available. Rates are percentages. Seeded reference data, not legal advice — the withholdable base it is applied to is real (from supply_chain royalty + service legs).

corridors.basis: UK–Switzerland DTT — royalties taxable only in residence (0% at source)
Irish domestic royalty exemption / EU interest-royalty directive — 0%
US model treaty royalties art. 12 — 0% at source for treaty residents
Switzerland levies no domestic WHT on royalties
India royalties — 10% reduced treaty rate (OECD-model partners)
